query:
UPDATE incoming_shares
               SET status = $2,
                   revoked_at = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('revoked'::share_status, 'tombstoned'::share_status)
                                          AND revoked_at IS NULL
                                     THEN now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'
                                     ELSE revoked_at
                                END
               WHERE id = $1
